mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 4.0% triggers negative 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate persistent high unemployment and reduced consumer spending, dampening equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) during the period when UNRATE crosses above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When demand growth (GDPC1) rises >2% and the federal funds rate falls >0.5% in the prior month, the combination signals accommodative monetary policy and strong demand, driving positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >2% and FEDFUNDS falls >0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: The interaction does not occur or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 3.5% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and generating negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) during the late-cycle expansion period when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in INDPRO above 94.8756 indicates robust business activity and corporate profits, boosting equity valuations and producing positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise for 3 months or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in HOUST above 550 units signals a sharp increase in industrial production demand, leading to short-term positive 5-day forward returns as market anticipates growth.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) after HOUST crosses above 550.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) rises >1% and unemployment (UNRATE) falls >0.2% simultaneously, it signals labor market strengthening, boosting consumer confidence and equity returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises >1% and UNRATE falls >0.2% in the prior month
failure_condition: The interaction does not occur or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS alongside rising INDPRO signals accommodative policy and robust business activity, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: regime: post-shock recovery and FEDFUNDS falls >1% while INDPRO rises >2% in the prior month
failure_condition: The regime is not active or the proxies do not move as expected, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).
